manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0136; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘Is this a good idea?’, ‘It is a good idea.’ and ‘The bus is a good idea too.’ are natural A1 English.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: idea is consistently mapped to «ایده» and the travel-choice prompts preserve meaning.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: All scored distractors are grammatical, natural and contrastive.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: One lexical target plus a familiar present-be yes/no question keeps the task bounded; no new grammar target is scored in this draft.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The target moves from a general proposal to the bus option without sense drift.

overallCoherence.evidence: Story, outcome and tasks all support evaluating a simple idea.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No visual claim exists; all listening sources are audioRequired turns exposed through A02 first.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
